description: This file defines options and validation logic for configuring Azure Cosmos DB clustering within the Orleans framework. It contains a class 'CosmosClusteringOptions' for setting cluster-specific options and a validator class 'CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator' for validating those options.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring Azure Cosmos DB clustering, inheriting from CosmosOptions. It sets a default container name for the cluster.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for CosmosClusteringOptions, ensuring that the options meet required validation rules.

methods.name: CosmosClusteringOptions
methods.description: Constructor initializing the clustering options with default container name.

methods.name: CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with specific options and name, inheriting validation logic from base class.
